weapon.d: Effective against flying foes. Inflicts Spd-5. Unit attacks twice (even if foe initiates combat). When under player's control, unit gains: "If unit initiates combat, foe cannot make a follow-up attack."

special.d: If unit initiates combat, grants another action to unit after combat. (Once per turn.) When Special triggers, inflicts "restricts movement to 1 space" on unit and Pair Up cohort through their next action.

At the start of turn 1, grants Special cooldown count-1. If unit initiates combat and Special is triggered, grants unit another action after combat. (Activates after combat where Special is triggered. Once per turn.) When Special triggers, inflicts "restricts movement to 1 space" on unit and Pair Up cohort through their next action.

a.d: At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Res+3, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Res+4, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP = 100%, grants Atk/Res+5, but if unit attacked, deals 1 damage to unit after combat.
At start of combat, if unit's HP ≥ 25%, grants Atk/Res+7, but after combat, if unit attacked, deals 5 damage to unit.

b.d: At the start of turn 1, restores 99 HP and grants Special cooldown count-1.

c.d: Inflicts Def-3 on foes within 2 spaces of target through their next actions after combat.
Inflicts Def-5 on foes within 2 spaces of target through their next actions after combat.
Inflicts Def-7 on foes within 2 spaces of target through their next actions after combat.
Grants Atk+2 to adjacent allies during combat.
Grants Atk+2 to allies within 2 spaces during combat.
Grants Atk+3 to allies within 2 spaces during combat.
Grants Atk+4 to allies within 2 spaces during combat. If unit is within 2 spaces of an ally, grants Atk+4 to unit during combat.
